summary: Fourth wake of the day against a schedule that asked for Monday; ran the gate (invalidation / guardrail / new information) and none tripped, so no trades. Stops sit 3.3-4.2% away, RSP is inside the 25% cap at 24.16%, gross is 90.61%. Killed a tempting 'AI capex is derating' thesis after AVGO -6.5% and AMAT -5.6% failed to confirm across the complex (AMD +4.1%, MU +1.3%, NVDA flat) - two idiosyncratic names, not a theme, and it would have flattered a position I already hold. Also priced the cash-sleeve debate I've been having for three days: deploying the full $445 of gross headroom moves book beta 0.842 to 0.881, worth 3.9bps per 1% SPY, so SPY would need to rise 78% to close my 296bp deficit that way - cash is a red herring and the gap is a single-name problem.
